question: Jab koi shakhs mashkook halaat mein foat ho jaye, to police ko maut ki wajah ki baaqaida tehqeeqaat karni hoti hai — kya hamara system yeh kahin darj karta hai, khaas tor par jab hamare itne cases mein maut shamil hai?
expected_answer: Code of Criminal Procedure, 1898 ki dafa 174 officer in charge ko paband karti hai ke jab use maloom ho ke koi shakhs khudkushi se, qatl se, ya aise halaat mein mara gaya jo shak paida karte hain, to woh tehqeeqaat kare aur maut ki zaahiri wajah par ek report tayyar kare — jism par mojood zakhmon ya nishaanaat ki tafseel ke saath — aur ise qareeb tareen magistrate ko bheje. Hamara data zahir karta hai ke aise cases mojood hain: 10 FIRs qatl ki dafa (PPC 302) ka hawala dete hain, aur kai zabt shuda property entries meyyat ke warisaan ko wapas karne ke liye nishaanzad hain. Magar schema mein kahin koi inquest, post-mortem ya cause-of-death record nahi. FIR aur uski dafaat yeh darj karti hain ke maut ka daawa kiya gaya hai; woh alag qanooni maut ki tehqeeqaat ko darj nahi kartin.
